summary: An authenticated Lumen Layouts SVG floor-planning workspace where users create durable plans, manipulate fixtures on a pan/zoom canvas, undo and redo edits, switch plans, export summaries, and print reports.

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates, edits, saves, and reloads a floor plan

steps.expect: email, password, sign in, and create account controls are visible

steps.action: create or sign in to an account with platform authentication
steps.expect: the workspace route opens and the signed-in account indicator is visible
the plan title Main Gallery Lighting Plan is shown above an empty SVG canvas

steps.action: drag a fixture from the library onto the SVG canvas
steps.expect: a visible fixture appears on the canvas and the inspector shows it as selected

steps.action: edit the selected fixture position, rotation, and brightness in the inspector
steps.expect: the SVG fixture moves, rotates, and displays the updated brightness value in the inspector
a Saved status is visible with the plan title still shown
the saved plan title, fixture location, rotation, and brightness are still visible after the page reload

acceptance: a created plan remains visible after a full browser reload
a fixture edited in the inspector keeps its saved position, rotation, and brightness after reload

journeys.title: A user pans and zooms the SVG canvas

steps.expect: the saved plan and SVG canvas are visible

steps.action: use canvas controls to pan and zoom
steps.expect: the zoom percentage changes and canvas content shifts within the viewport
a Saved status is visible
the saved zoom percentage and panned canvas position are restored

acceptance: the zoom indicator changes when zoom controls are used
the saved viewport is restored after reload

journeys.title: A keyboard user selects and moves fixtures without dragging

steps.expect: the canvas, fixture list, and inspector are visible

steps.action: move keyboard focus to the fixture list and select a fixture
steps.expect: the selected fixture is outlined on the SVG canvas and its inspector values are visible

steps.action: use keyboard arrow controls to move the selected fixture
steps.expect: the inspector x and y values change and the selected SVG fixture moves

steps.action: use keyboard controls to rotate and adjust brightness
steps.expect: the inspector rotation and brightness values change and the fixture appearance updates

acceptance: a fixture can be selected using keyboard-accessible controls
keyboard changes update the same visible inspector values as pointer changes

journeys.title: A user undoes and redoes fixture changes

steps.expect: the saved plan and selected fixture inspector are visible
the new brightness value is visible on the inspector
the previous brightness value is restored and the redo control becomes enabled
the changed brightness value is visible again and the undo control remains enabled

acceptance: undo visibly restores the previous fixture value
redo visibly reapplies the undone fixture value

journeys.title: A user creates a second plan and switches between saved plans

steps.expect: the saved primary plan is listed in the plan switcher
Lobby Alternate Layout is shown as the current plan title

steps.action: choose the first saved plan from the plan switcher
steps.expect: Main Gallery Lighting Plan is shown as the current plan title

steps.action: choose the second saved plan from the plan switcher
steps.expect: Lobby Alternate Layout is shown as the current plan title

acceptance: the plan switcher lists more than one saved plan
selecting a plan changes the visible plan title and canvas state

journeys.title: A user views the separate fixture library route

steps.expect: the Lumen Layouts fixture library is visible
lighting fixtures are visible in the library results

acceptance: the library route is separate from the workspace route
the fixture library shows selectable fixture templates

journeys.title: A user exports and prints a plan summary

steps.expect: a plan selector and report preview area are visible

steps.action: select the saved plan for reporting
steps.expect: the report preview shows the plan title and a fixture count
a downloadable summary file is produced and the screen shows Export ready
a print-ready summary view is visible with the plan title and fixture table

acceptance: the exported summary includes the selected plan title
the print view includes a visible fixture table

journeys.title: A user opens settings and signs out

steps.expect: account settings and workspace preference controls are visible

steps.action: change the keyboard pan step preference
steps.expect: the updated keyboard pan step value is displayed
a Settings saved confirmation is visible
the sign-in page is visible and workspace routes are no longer shown

acceptance: settings are shown on a separate route
signing out returns the user to the sign-in page

routes.name: Sign In
routes.purpose: Authenticate users with the platform auth controls before accessing saved floor plans.

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: Create, select, edit, pan, zoom, undo, redo, and save SVG floor plans.

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: Browse fixture templates available for placement in plans.

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: Preview, export, and print summaries for saved plans.

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: View account status and edit workspace preferences.

routes.name: Home Redirect
routes.purpose: Send signed-in users to the workspace and signed-out visitors to sign in.

entities.name: authSession
relationships: authSession represents the visible sign-in form state and authenticated browser session, not durable user data

entities.name: plan
relationships: a signed-in user owns many plans
a plan stores many fixtures inside its fixtures JSON state

entities.name: workspacePreference
relationships: a signed-in user has workspace preferences that can reference the active plan

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: a signed-out visitor is redirected to /signin when opening /workspace, /library, /reports, or /settings
a signed-in user only sees plans and workspace preferences owned by that user
signing out hides workspace content and returns the browser to the sign-in page

operations.description: Authenticate the visible email and password controls through the platform auth SDK and open the workspace on success.

responsibilities.behavior: use platform authentication with the supplied email and password, set the visible session state to signed in, and navigate to the workspace when authentication succeeds

operations.description: End the platform auth session and return the browser to the sign-in page.

responsibilities.behavior: sign out through the platform auth SDK, clear the visible session state, and navigate to the sign-in page

operations.description: Initialize and persist a new user-owned floor plan using db.entity('plan').create.

responsibilities.behavior: initialize a new plan with an empty fixture list, default viewport, empty undo and redo history, no selected fixture, and an updated timestamp

operations.description: Persist the current plan state using db.entity('plan').update.
Add a chosen fixture template to the current plan and persist the updated plan state.

responsibilities.behavior: create a fixture instance from the selected library item, place it on the canvas, select it, expose its inspector values, clear redo history, and push the previous state onto undo history

operations.description: Apply inspector edits to the selected fixture and persist the changed plan state.

responsibilities.behavior: update the selected fixture with inspector position, rotation, and brightness values, clear redo history, and push the previous state onto undo history

operations.description: Update the canvas viewport for panning and zooming and persist it on the plan.

responsibilities.behavior: change the viewport pan offset and zoom level

operations.description: Restore the previous plan state from undo history.

responsibilities.behavior: move the current editable plan state to redo history and restore the most recent undo state

operations.description: Reapply an undone plan state from redo history.

responsibilities.behavior: move the current editable plan state to undo history and restore the most recent redo state

operations.description: Persist the currently selected active plan for the signed-in user.
Persist workspace preference values for the signed-in user.
Generate a downloadable plan summary from the selected saved plan.

responsibilities.behavior: produce a downloadable text summary containing plan title, last saved time, fixture count, and fixture table

operations.description: Render a print-ready summary for the selected saved plan.

responsibilities.behavior: produce a print-ready report view containing plan title, fixture count, and fixture table

states.loading: authenticating message while sign-in or account creation is in progress
states.validation: email must look like an email and password is required
states.success: workspace opens with signed-in account indicator

states.loading: loading plans message while owned plans are fetched
states.empty: no plans yet message with a create plan control
states.validation: plan name is required before creating or saving
states.error: saving failed, try again message is visible
states.success: Saved status is visible after persistence succeeds

states.loading: canvas loading message while the current plan state is prepared
states.empty: empty canvas message is visible when the plan has no fixtures
states.validation: fixture position, rotation, and brightness accept numeric values with brightness constrained to the visible slider range
states.error: canvas update failed message is visible
states.success: fixture selection outline and updated inspector values are visible

states.loading: loading fixture library message is visible
states.empty: no fixtures match this category message is visible
states.validation: category selection must be one of the visible library categories

states.loading: loading report preview message is visible
states.empty: select a plan to preview a report message is visible
states.validation: a plan must be selected before export or print
states.error: report generation failed message is visible
states.success: Export ready or print-ready summary view is visible

states.validation: keyboard pan step must be a positive number
states.error: settings save failed message is visible

acceptance.statement: a signed-out visitor opening /workspace is shown the sign-in page instead of plan data
a submitted plan name appears as the workspace title after creation
a saved fixture's position, rotation, and brightness are readable after a full page reload
undo restores the previous visible fixture value and redo reapplies the changed value
switching plans changes the visible plan title and canvas contents
exporting a report produces a downloadable summary for the selected plan and shows Export ready
printing a report shows a print-ready view containing the selected plan title and fixture table

deferred.reason: the requested workspace only requires in-app SVG planning and export of a plan summary
the request requires user-owned durable plans, not simultaneous collaborative editing
brightness editing is required as fixture state, but physically accurate rendering is not requested
